links.outcome: Readability grade level of chatbot responses to pre-anesthesia patient queries
links.effect: ChatGPT responses were difficult to read (college level); Bard responses were about 8th grade level by readability calculations.
links.quote: ChatGPT responses were difficult to read (college level difficulty) while Bard responses were more conversational and about 8 th grade level from readability calculations.

links.outcome: Clinician-evaluated hallucination errors in chatbot responses to anesthesia queries
links.effect: No hallucination errors reported for ChatGPT; 30.3% error in Bard responses.
links.quote: Upon clinical evaluation, no “hallucination” errors were reported from ChatGPT, whereas we observed a 30.3% error in response from Bard.

screen.reason: Evaluates baseline performance, hallucinations, readability, and sentiment of ChatGPT vs. Bard on patient-oriented anesthesia queries without testing a deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
